decks.opportunity_title: Part-week deprescribing pharmacist for care homes
decks.role_title: Senior primary care clinical pharmacist, care homes

cards.name: Polypharmacy medication review
cards.how_to_earn: Show it by walking through how you would run a structured review for one complex anonymised older patient, then compare your steps with the CPPE page.
cards.resource_title: Fundamentals of structured medication review : CPPE

cards.name: Deprescribing in frailty
cards.how_to_earn: Take the STOPP/START version 3 paper and apply five criteria to a recent older patient's drug chart, noting what you would stop or start.
cards.resource_title: STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3 - PMC

cards.name: Medicines reconciliation
cards.how_to_earn: Show it with a short example of a discrepancy you caught on admission and how you resolved it against the GP record.

cards.name: Antimicrobial stewardship
cards.how_to_earn: Show it by outlining how you would adapt your ward approach to care home prescribing, such as urinary tract infection treatment.

cards.name: Clinical governance
cards.how_to_earn: Show it by describing an audit or incident review you led and how you would repeat it across several care homes.

cards.name: Independent prescribing readiness
cards.how_to_earn: Read the CPPE page on preparing to train and list which requirements you already meet and which you need to evidence.
cards.resource_title: Preparing to train as an independent prescriber : CPPE

cards.name: Care home team communication
cards.how_to_earn: Show it by drafting a short, tactful message to a care home manager recommending a medicine change.

cards.name: Primary care role progression
cards.how_to_earn: Skim the pathway handbook and note where a senior post sits and which capabilities it expects.
cards.resource_title: Primary care pharmacy education pathway Pathway and role progression handbook

stories.title: Pharmacist in practice: ‘What attracts me to the PCN world is the variety it offers’ - The Pharmacist
stories.why_watch: A PCN pharmacist describes the day to day variety of the role, which helps you judge whether it suits you.

stories.title: 051 Ryan Smith: A jack of all trades - Primary Care Network (PCN) Pharmacist, Clinical Director for MORPh Consultancy, and Clinical Director for The Pharmacist Network by Pharmacist Diaries
stories.why_watch: A podcast conversation showing how a PCN pharmacist career can widen into leadership and consultancy.

decks.opportunity_title: Clinical pharmacist working alongside AI medicines safety tools

cards.name: Reconciling medicines with AI
cards.how_to_earn: Pick one recent reconciliation you did and describe, in a few lines, the exact points where you would not trust an automated list without checking.

cards.name: Spotting AI dosing errors
cards.how_to_earn: Read the abstract on hallucinated dosing, then ask a general AI tool a dosing question you know well and note whether it gets the detail right.
cards.resource_title: Hallucinated dosing: An emerging medication safety risk in generative AI

cards.name: Challenging AI prescribing suggestions
cards.how_to_earn: Take three prescriptions junior doctors recently brought you and write the one question you would put to an AI tool's suggestion for each.

cards.name: Clinical safety standards knowledge
cards.how_to_earn: Read a plain English guide to DCB0160 and note which of its steps look like incident reviews you already do.
cards.resource_title: DCB0160 Guide: Clinical Risk Management Standard for GP Practices

cards.name: Clinical safety officer duties
cards.how_to_earn: Read what a clinical safety officer does and list two duties you could already evidence from your ward work.
cards.resource_title: What Is a Clinical Safety Officer? Role, Requirements & How to Appoint One

cards.name: Governing AI tool risk
cards.how_to_earn: Show how you would take an AI tool's near miss through your usual governance route, from report to learning, in a one page outline.
cards.resource_title: What is DCB0160? Understanding Clinical Safety Standards

cards.name: Benchmarking AI against pharmacists
cards.how_to_earn: Skim the introduction and results of this benchmarking study and note what kinds of prescription review errors the models made compared with pharmacists.
cards.resource_title: Human-Level and Beyond: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Clinical Pharmacists in Prescription Review

cards.name: Teaching colleagues safe AI use
cards.how_to_earn: Adapt your intake induction into a one page outline of what a new user must check before relying on an AI tool.

stories.title: AI in Pharmacy: What's Next? - YouTube
stories.why_watch: A pharmacy focused look at where AI is heading, so you can hear the opportunities and concerns in practitioners' own terms.

stories.title: Pharmacists Seek AI-Driven Solutions To Address Medication Errors - YouTube
stories.why_watch: Shows how pharmacists are framing AI as a way to reduce medication errors, which is the safety question you would be reviewing.
